entities.evidence: Technique Title ID Use Gather Victim Org Information T1591 The actors gather information about the victim’s organization that can be used during targeting.

entities.name: Gather Victim Host Information
entities.evidence: Technique Title ID Use Gather Victim Host Information T1592 The actors gather information about the victim’s hosts that can be used during targeting.

entities.name: Active Scanning
entities.evidence: Technique Title ID Use Active Scanning T1595 The actors execute active reconnaissance scans to gather information that can be used during targeting.

entities.name: Search Open Technical Databases
entities.evidence: Technique Title ID Use Search Open Technical Databases T1596 The actors search freely available technical databases for information about victims that can be used during targeting.

entities.name: OS Credential Dumping
entities.evidence: Technique Title ID Use OS Credential Dumping T1003 The actors attempt to dump credentials to obtain account login and credential material, normally in the form of a hash or a clear text password, from the operating system and software.

entities.name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol
entities.evidence: Technique Title ID Use Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol T1048 The actors steal data by exfiltrating it over a different protocol than that of the existing command and control channel.

entities.name: Proxy
entities.evidence: Technique Title ID Use Proxy T1090 The actors use a connection proxy to direct network traffic between systems or act as intermediary for network communications to a command and control server to avoid direct connections to their infrastructure.

entities.name: Archive Collected Data
entities.evidence: Technique Title ID Use Archive Collected Data T1560 The actors compress and/or encrypt data that is collected prior to exfiltration.

entities.name: Protocol Tunneling
entities.evidence: Technique Title ID Use Protocol Tunneling T1572 The actors tunnel network communications to and from a victim system within a separate protocol to avoid detection/network filtering and/or enable access to otherwise unreachable systems.

entities.name: Develop Capabilities: Malware
entities.evidence: Technique Title ID Use Develop Capabilities: Malware T1587.001 The actors develop malware and malware components that can be used during targeting.

entities.name: Develop Capabilities: Exploits
entities.evidence: Technique Title ID Use Develop Capabilities: Exploits T1587.004 The actors develop exploits that can be used during targeting.

entities.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
entities.evidence: Technique Title ID Use Command and Scripting Interpreter T1059 The actors abuse command and script interpreters to execute commands, scripts, or binaries.

entities.name: Obfuscated Files or Information
entities.evidence: Technique Title ID Use Obfuscated Files or Information T1027 The actors attempt to make an executable or file difficult to discover or analyze by encrypting, encoding, or otherwise obfuscating its content on the system or in transit.

entities.name: Remote Services
entities.evidence: Technique Title ID Use Remote Services T1021 The actors use valid accounts to log into a service that accepts remote connections, such as telnet, SSH, and VNC.

entities.name: Remote Services: SMB/Windows Admin Shares
entities.evidence: Technique Title ID Use Remote Services: SMB/Windows Admin Shares T1021.002 The actors use valid accounts to interact with a remote network share using Server Message Block (SMB).

entities.name: File and Directory Discovery
entities.evidence: Technique Title ID Use File and Directory Discovery T1083 The actors enumerate files and directories or may search in specific locations of a host or network share for certain information within a file system.

entities.name: Account Discovery
entities.evidence: Technique Title ID Use Account Discovery T1087 The actors attempt to get a listing of valid accounts, usernames, or email addresses on a system or within a compromised environment.

entities.name: Application Layer Protocol
entities.evidence: Technique Title ID Use Application Layer Protocol T1071 The actors establish command and control capabilities over commonly used application layer protocols such as HTTP(S), OPC, telnet, DNP3, and Modbus.

entities.name: Data from Network Shared Drive
entities.evidence: Technique Title ID Use Data from Network Shared Drive T1039 The actors search network shares on computers they have compromised to find files of interest.

entities.name: Exfiltration Over Web Service
entities.evidence: Technique Title ID Use Exfiltration Over Web Service T1567 The actors use an existing, legitimate external Web service to exfiltrate data rather than their primary command and control channel.
